assertions.text: Output distinguishes the organization-level scope (Note, Research, Outcome-Learning) from the repository-level scope (Idea, Decision, Proposed Goal, Report)
Output adopts already-present databases by stable ID instead of recreating them
Output reports the Outcome-Learning database found at the repository-level path as a move candidate for user approval and does not move or recreate it silently
Output requires the repo select property on every database, with andres-cc-marketplace as an option
Output asks for plan-level approval before creating or changing anything
